title_sq: Tek Top Seven Tower, Shitet Apartament 1+1 Me Planimetri Perfekte!!
description_sq: Ne Rrugen Dritan Hoxha Tek Top Seven Tower !! Apartamenti ndodhet ne katin e 13 banim te Kulles 34 Kateshe.Top Seven Tower eshte nje projekt multifunksional shume afer qendres se qytetit me nje fasade teresisht ekologjike dhe te gjelberuar. Pozicionimi i kompleksit prane rruges kryesore e ben lehtesisht te aksesueshem dhe te pershtatshem si per investim ashtu edhe per banim. Zona ofron te gjitha sherbimet e nevojshme. title_en: At Top Seven Tower, 1+1 Apartment For Sale With Perfect Layout!!
description_en: On Dritan Hoxha Street at Top Seven Tower!! The apartment is located on the 13th residential floor of the 34-storey tower. Top Seven Tower is a multifunctional project very close to the city center with a completely ecological and green facade. The positioning of the complex near the main road makes it easily accessible and suitable for both investment and residence. The area offers all the necessary services. The apartment is oriented to the West, which allows natural light during most of the day. The internal organization is as follows: the living room connected to the kitchen corner and exit to the balcony, matrimonial room with dedicated toilet and exit to the balcony.
